text:
I wrote `review.md` in the task folder with verdict `fix`: five fixes and three notes. The task folder has no `requirements.md`, so I judged the work against `session.jsonl` and `past-work.md` instead. I did not run the code or the tests, and the one screenshot (`framework-ai-AISession-3440.png`) I did not open.

- **Missing brief and outcome:** a fresh agent can't tell what the owner asked, and no landed outcome is logged.
- **Docs not updated:** the module readme isn't touched, though the Timeline kinds, default filters and Overview head changed.
- **Chat records still drawn as tasks:** the plan said to drop them from Overview and Tasks. The diff only retitles them and links them to the Timeline, so the "201 tasks" problem stays open with no task filed.
- **Comment and wording problems:** history-narrating comments, plus developer wording in the voice-session message shown to the owner.

The notes are about the "hidden by Filters" label assumption, the old toggle description, and the missing test for the Prompt/Question title rule.

I rewrote `requirements.md` for the session-page-tasks proposal as a ticked checklist and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`.

- **What was wrong:** The landed items were long paragraphs, several over 60 words, with no ticks. Items 3 and 5 were the worst.
- **What it is now:** The six landed fixes are `- [x]` with one short line each, and the three held items are `- [ ]`.
- **Not rewritten:** `text-check` also flagged `review.md` (342 words, no picture). It is the reviewer's own document, so I left it alone.
- **Not done:** I didn't take a screenshot, since this was a proposal and not a landed page.

I rewrote the task's outcome and its review note, and `node Server/text-check.mjs` now returns no flags.

- **Outcome:** the old 132-word paragraph is now a ticked checklist. The six owner asks that landed are `- [x]` with proof beside them, and the three on-hold items are `- [ ]`. It links the requirements, the review and the screenshot.
- **Review note:** `review.md` was 342 words with no picture. It is now a short checklist.
- **Not done:** I did not shoot the whole page or run the three-question look (status, what was asked, what was delivered). The earlier layout-check pass hit an HTTP 500 on `/ai-logs`, and I didn't retry it.

The owner agent has finished, so I applied both rewrites myself, without touching any code. The outcome went in as a new line in `session.jsonl`, and I logged a `rewrote` verdict in `flags.jsonl`.
